description: Grail gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Grail trailer for this upcoming fast-paced deckbuilder where your deck fights for you. description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Welcome to Kowloon, a first-person psychological horror game developed by a1esska, Notex, N4bA, and Admia. Seek the truth of Kowloon in Welcome to Kowloon, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S, with the game being available now for PC (Steam).

description: Here's your look at the Invariant teaser trailer for this upcoming Antarctic sci-fi horror FPS game. Explore a vast underground complex, confront hostile creatures, solve puzzles, manage resources, and uncover the secrets hidden deep beneath the ice. Invariant will be available on PC.
title: Invariant - Official Teaser Trailer

description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Shellshock, a WW1 adventure walking simulation game developed by Man the Barricades. author: GameTrailers
description:
Hell Galaxy leaves early access and version 1.0 will be available on Steam on July 31, 2026. Watch the Hell Galaxy version 1.0 release date trailer for this single-player space shooter game that blends weird fiction, dark gritty sci-fi, and transhumanism. Version 1.0 will feature the full story, new quests, and 2 new boss battles. 

In Hell Galaxy, death is not an escape; it's the beginning of your sentence.

Set in the haunting depths of the Neterun galaxy, Hell Galaxy is a battle for both body and mind. Players will engage in dynamic space dogfights using fully customisable loadouts and shifting combat stances to adapt to increasingly deadly threats, while ghostly entities and colossal monstrosities threaten not only the integrity of their ship, but also their very sanity.
title: Hell Galaxy - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Reverse: 1999 x Atomic Heart collaboration trailer as the utopian and retrofuturistic world of the first-person shooter Atomic Heart gets a crossover with the 20th-century time-travel strategic RPG Reverse: 1999. The Reverse: 1999 x Atomic Heart collaboration features two new playable characters and an original crossover story based on Atomic Heart’s alternate history setting. Advanced humanoid robot bodyguard The Twins and antagonist repair cabinet Nora will have fresh narratives. 

Meanwhile, Reverse: 1999 characters, including Vertin, X, Madam Lucy and Mesmer Jr., will take a trip to Facility 3826 (Atomic Heart’s world) for this new adventure. New themed cosmetics bring retrofuturism style to characters in the Reverse: 1999 universe. 

The Reverse: 1999 x Atomic Heart crossover collaboration event begins on July 23, 2026 on PC and mobile.
title: Reverse: 1999 x Atomic Heart - Official Collaboration Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Shift at Midnight gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release date announcement. Watch the Shift at Midnight release date announcement trailer for this upcoming online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide. Shift at Midnight will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox Cloud, Xbox on PC, and Steam on July 22, 2026.
title: Shift at Midnight - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Forest Escape: Last Train is available now in Steam Early Access. Watch the Forest Escape: Last Train Early Access launch trailer for this co-op surreal horror exploration game for 1-4 players. 

Forest Escape: Last Train launches with a fully explorable world featuring 13 unique locations and mini-games: from a misty forest full of wandering teeth and cursed dolls to a carousel haunted by a giant clown, an eye the size of a building floating in a lake, a football pitch with a mechanical goalkeeper, and a maze you'll want to escape almost as badly as the forest itself. Three different starting points ensure no two runs begin the same way, while Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty settings mean the Warden's unhinged world can break players of any experience level.
title: Forest Escape: Last Train - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Clay Clinic Co-op announcement trailer for the upcoming chaotic co-op hospital game for up to 4 player. In Clay Clinic Co-op, barely qualified doctors try to survive short medical shifts filled with strange symptoms, dangerous equipment, risky procedures, and escalating team-wide disasters. Diagnose strange symptoms, move patients between treatment rooms, use medical tools, run procedures, and try to keep everyone alive long enough to finish the shift.

Clay Clinic Co-op will be available on PC.


Wishlist the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4882500/Clay_Clinic/
title: Clay Clinic Co-op - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at gameplay and more from The Sinking City 2 in this trailer for the upcoming Lovecraftian survival horror game. The new trailer also showcases details of the bonus in-game content with pre-orders. The Sinking City 2 will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on August 18, 2026.

The Sinking City 2 is set in a Lovecraftian vision of 1920s America, in the infamous city of Arkham. A supernatural flood has driven out all but the most deranged residents, leaving decay and eldritch horrors that roam the streets. Step into the role of Calvin Rafferty, an occult adventurer whose cavalier actions have led to devastating consequences. After a dreaming ritual goes wrong, his girlfriend, Faye, is left trapped in a mysterious sleep. Now Calvin must navigate the drowned streets of a derelict city in a desperate attempt to bring her back. On his quest, he’ll come face-to-face with a plague of otherworldly creatures, the Slither, who possess and twist the dead
title: The Sinking City 2 - Official 'Provisions Of Sanity' Trailer

author: GameTrailers

Explore procedurally generated biomes, attain new abilities, and assemble powerful builds from run to run. Garden Souls is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Garden Souls - Official Reveal Trailer
